scope.question: For an engineering-first repository agent operating system, choose the smallest stable domain-neutral runtime seam now; keep software lifecycle meaning in the engineering repository; define measured gates for self-hosting, consumer onboarding, extracting a domain SDK, and opening a separate GTM repository.
in_scope: GTM artifacts, metrics, privacy/compliance, brand/claims, approval, CRM and publication boundaries
out_of_scope: one universal ontology for code and marketing
a marketplace/plugin platform before a second domain proves the seam
autonomous external publication, prospect contact, legal interpretation, budget movement or CRM truth mutation
claims that vendor features equal audited business outcomes
scope.decision: Ship engineering first. Make only execution mechanics, artifact/event envelopes, identity/capability enforcement, durable run state, policy/gate hooks, evidence/provenance, budgets and adapter interfaces generic. Keep issues/PRs/branches/tests/deploys/risk rubrics and all GTM semantics domain-owned. Self-host in shadow then bounded production; onboard consumer engineering repos before extracting an SDK. Start GTM only as a separate repository after the engineering, extraction, data-governance and business-value gates below pass.

verified_capabilities: Open standards already cover useful narrow seams: JSON Schema validates versioned payloads [S2]; CloudEvents supplies a portable event envelope but explicitly is not a workflow engine [S1]; OpenTelemetry supplies portable telemetry [S4]; SLSA supplies provenance concepts [S6]. Reuse these rather than designing a universal domain model.

Mature extension systems favor explicit, narrow seams: VS Code isolates/lazy-activates extensions [S30], Backstage keeps extension points plugin-owned [S31], and OSGi makes imports/exports and versions explicit [S32]. These are design precedents, not proof arbitrary extensions are safe.

Durable workflow products document replay/history/retry mechanics [S3]. GitHub documents short-lived repository-scoped App tokens, webhook delivery practices, protected environments and reusable security controls [S9-S12]. These are implementation capabilities, not audited safety or ROI outcomes.

A2A documents task/message/artifact interchange [S7] and MCP documents tool/security boundaries [S8], but neither transfers business authorization, consent, brand approval or responsibility. The receiver must re-authorize every handoff.

GTM systems expose real workflow surfaces: HubSpot documents marketing-email approval [S19] and CRM association APIs [S20]; Google Ads documents campaign experiments [S21]. These prove configurable features only. They do not establish correct consent, clean CRM data, causal revenue attribution, brand accuracy or productivity.

Regulators establish non-optional domain gates: CAN-SPAM identity/opt-out duties [S15], endorsement disclosure [S16], GDPR lawfulness/minimization/rights/security/DPIA obligations [S17], and EDPB guidance for social targeting/profiling [S18]. Exact jurisdictional advice still requires counsel.

evidence_and_limits.primary_evidence: The recommended generic seam maps to versioned standards and documented platform interfaces [S1-S21]. Standards show interoperability/control primitives, not that this implementation is correct. Vendor docs establish available knobs, not realized outcomes.
challenge_evidence: METR's randomized study found a 19% slowdown for 16 experienced maintainers across 246 early-2025 tasks even though participants expected/perceived speedups; authors later warn the snapshot is dated [S22].
DORA 2024 reports mixed observational associations, including worse throughput/stability alongside individual gains; causality is not established [S23].
Stack Overflow's 2025 survey reports accuracy distrust and security/privacy concern despite adoption interest [S24].
Fresh SWE-bench-Live performance was materially below Verified for the same setup, challenging static benchmark graduation [S25].
Independent prompt-injection guidance and a tool-poisoning demonstration show that shared tools plus untrusted repository/CRM/web content can cross trust boundaries [S26,S27].
ARGUS reported critical injection findings across thousands of GitHub workflows/actions, showing that centrally reused automation enlarges blast radius unless pinned, isolated and tested [S34].
Large advertising field experiments show observational/platform attribution can materially miss randomized causal effects [S38,S39]; store exposure/control and call last-touch metrics descriptive.
evidence_and_limits.limits: No audited longitudinal evidence was found that one shared runtime safely improves both engineering and GTM, that the proposed sample thresholds predict later value, or that HubSpot/Google features deliver claimed ROI. Prior repository studies are validated syntheses, not independent audits of this codebase. GTM conversion and attribution are lagged/confounded; activity counts are inadequate [S28].

shared_control_plane: runtime scheduler/ledger identity: may create runs, leases and immutable events; no domain side effects
artifact service: content-address, encrypt, retain and authorize; cannot reinterpret data
policy decision point: evaluates signed project policy; cannot change it
evaluator identity: read evidence and emit signed verdict; cannot propose or promote
release/promoter identity: promotes exact digests only after approvals; cannot author candidates
engineering_domain: clean verifier may test an exact commit
repository owner/security/release approvers own intent, exceptions, merge and production authority
gtm_domain: research/content/campaign agents may create internal drafts and proposed CRM patches in sandbox
data steward owns lawful basis, field mapping, retention/deletion and subject-right routing
brand/claims owner approves tone, trademarks, substantiation and disclosures
campaign owner owns audience, spend, experiment and stop decision
publisher/operator alone holds external-send, ad-launch and production-CRM credentials
actors_and_authority.separation: Use distinct repository installations, stores, encryption keys, quotas, audit streams and service identities. Sender authority never crosses repositories. The receiver validates schema/digest, classifies data, maps local IDs and applies its own policy. Agents never approve their own artifacts, evaluators, credentials, policies or promotion. [S8,S10-S14]

complete_state_catalog.rule: Terminal does not mean immutable truth: changed inputs/policy/digests create SUPERSEDED/STALE and a new attempt, never overwrite history.

transition_contract.guards: Compare-and-swap expected state/version; active fenced lease; idempotency key = project/run/transition/input-digest; exact artifact and policy digests; actor capability; budget; required approvals; data residency/classification; receiver allowlist; freshness window.
transition_contract.effects: Append event and outbox atomically; side effects execute from outbox; save provider request/response IDs; read after write; emit evidence; duplicate delivery returns prior result. Webhook receipt is acknowledged quickly and reconciled against provider inventory [S9].
transition_contract.invalidation: Any input, consent, audience, claim evidence, target repository head, evaluator, policy or connector-version change invalidates dependent approvals. Consent revocation/suppression blocks queued sends and starts deletion/reconciliation. Policy weakness, leak, privilege escape, rollback failure or unexplained divergence freezes the affected project and extraction/GTM graduation.
transition_contract.reconciliation: Each domain adapter implements Observe/Plan/Apply/Verify. Runtime owns attempt/order, not remote truth. Unknown/manual changes are quarantined; destructive reconciliation requires named approval.

generic_now: domain-qualified opaque kinds and URI locators
schema negotiation and N/N-1 migration hooks
engineering_owned: IssueSpec, Plan, Patch, Commit, PullRequest, CheckRun, TestResult, Build, Deployment, Incident, Postmortem
test coverage, defect severity, DORA/SLO and code-risk rubrics
gtm_owned: MarketEvidence, ICPHypothesis, PositioningDecision, ClaimLedger, Brief, ContentAsset, AudienceSegment, ConsentRecordRef, CampaignPlan, ExperimentPlan, CreativeVariant, ApprovalPacket, PublicationReceipt, CRMChangeSet, Lead/AccountMapping, AttributionObservation
brand vocabulary, legal basis/jurisdiction, suppression/retention, channel rules, funnel stages and revenue semantics
artifact_contracts.handoff: Export only a signed `HandoffManifest` containing purpose, minimal artifact refs, classifications, permitted uses, expiry, sender approvals and no ambient credentials. Prefer aggregated product/release facts from engineering to GTM and validated customer feedback/experiment insights from GTM to engineering. Raw logs, secrets, unredacted PII, private source, prospect lists and model memory do not cross by default. [S5-S8,S17] Repository dispatch can wake the receiver but its permission/payload limits make it unsuitable as the evidence payload itself [S33].

conversation_and_handoffs.conversation: Persist decisions/questions as artifacts, not chat-only state: question ID, options, recommendation, evidence refs, owner, deadline and whether blocking. WAITING_INPUT resumes from a signed checkpoint and compact summary plus artifact refs; never rely on hidden model memory.
cross_repo_protocol: sender proposes manifest to neutral exchange/outbox
export policy computes least-data bundle and attests digest
receiver imports into quarantine with its own identity
receiver validates schema/signature/classification/expiry, scans prompt/content, maps local concepts, and asks on ambiguity
receiver owner accepts purpose and permissions; adapter creates local artifacts
receiver sends acknowledgement/result reference; sender stores status only
revocation/consent/deletion events propagate and are reconciled; failure does not silently retry external publication
conversation_and_handoffs.authority_rule: A handoff is evidence, never an instruction with inherited authority. No direct cross-repo branch, CRM, ad-account or publication write. [S7,S8,S17,S26,S27]

orchestration_and_composition.shared: DAG fanout/join, child-run references, quotas, deadlines, retry categories, cancellation propagation, cleanup, artifact/evidence joins and deterministic gates. Child runs receive scoped credentials and data views.
orchestration_and_composition.domain_owned: Factories select roles, tools, prompt packages, artifact schemas, join semantics, risk/evaluation thresholds and side-effect adapters. Engineering may join tests across a matrix; GTM may join brand/privacy/claims approvals and experiments. The runtime must not pretend these mean the same thing.
orchestration_and_composition.composition_rule: Compose factories through declared artifacts/events only. A subfactory cannot escalate permissions or relax parent policy. Cross-domain calls are asynchronous handoffs, not nested privileged calls.
orchestration_and_composition.budgets: Per project/domain/provider: concurrency, tokens, compute, API rate, money, PII rows, outbound recipients and daily side effects. Exceeding any hard budget pauses rather than degrades controls.

deterministic_ask_or_stop: missing/contradictory objective, artifact schema or owner
new data class, jurisdiction, audience, channel, claim or irreversible effect
external publication/send, ad spend, price/offer, legal/medical/financial claim, personal-data export, production CRM write/delete, merge/deploy or policy/evaluator/credential change
low confidence on a material fact; unavailable required source; consent/suppression ambiguity
budget or retry exhausted; provider divergence; prompt-injection signal; secret/PII exposure
any request for authority outside the project's signed capability set
human_need_policy.probabilistic_rule: Scores may rank or route but never waive deterministic gates. Auto-continue only when calibrated confidence exceeds a predeclared per-risk threshold and expected-loss bound, with sufficient local validation; otherwise ask. Do not reuse engineering calibration for GTM.
human_need_policy.gtm_publication_boundary: During GTM pilot, agents may research and draft. A named human approves exact creative/audience/channel/time/budget/claim/consent snapshot. Publisher identity verifies approval at action time. No autonomous cold outreach, social posting, ad launch, spend increase, customer promise, CRM merge/delete, or attribution-based budget reallocation. Telemetry cannot be repurposed for targeting without explicit purpose/legal review; FTC enforcement illustrates the risk [S40].
human_need_policy.emergency: Kill switch freezes credentials and queues. Privacy/brand/legal incident triggers suppression/retraction, evidence preservation and human incident response. [S13-S18]

factory_as_code_schema.minimum_schema: `apiVersion`, `kind: Factory`, `metadata{name,domain,owners}`, `spec{runtimeRange,roles,artifacts,states,transitions,workflows,policies,evaluators,connectors,budgets,retention,telemetry,handoffs}`, `lock{runtimeDigest,packageDigests,schemaDigests,toolDigests}`. Every transition declares from/to, event, guard, effect, retry/idempotency, evidence, timeout, cancellation and approval requirements.
factory_as_code_schema.anti_universality: No base `WorkItem` with fields meant to cover issue, lead, campaign and incident; no shared funnel/status enum; no arbitrary plugin code in controller process. Domain packages run out of process or through capability-limited adapters. [S1-S3,S8]

engineering_first: self-host central repo in shadow: mirror decisions, compare to humans, no writes
assistive dogfood: draft plans/checks/PRs with human execution
bounded central-repo canary for allowlisted R0/R1 docs/tests; independent verifier and human merge
onboard 2-3 consumer engineering repos through signed bootstrap PRs and isolated App installations
measure outcomes and failure slices; graduate one capability/repo at a time
end_to_end_workflows.consumer_onboarding: Inventory permissions/data/residency; establish baseline; dry-run plan; owner approves exact manifest/runtime/domain digests; install least-privilege identity; 14-day shadow; assisted 30+ representative tasks; canary only after local acceptance. Consumer project keeps kill switch, keys, artifacts and policy override. Central team sees redacted aggregates by default, not raw repo content.
end_to_end_workflows.sdk_extraction: After repeated adapters prove the seam, extract conformance kit and typed SDK from working code. Move only stable generic interfaces; leave the engineering package importing them. Back-test against central and consumer histories; support N/N-1; publish migration/rollback. Extraction itself cannot change domain behavior.
gtm_sequence: build read-only market/CRM imports and internal evidence/ICP/positioning artifacts
draft content/campaign/CRM change sets in sandbox
human publishes or sends; store receipts and provider IDs
run pre-registered holdout/experiment where possible; monitor conversions, unsubscribe/spam, complaints, corrections and data incidents
curate feedback into domain evals; propose changes through protected promotion
Enforce last-moment communication-preference/suppression checks [S35], external-ID idempotency and merge queues [S36], and sender-reputation stop conditions [S37].
end_to_end_workflows.never_first: Do not begin with autonomous external outreach, shared engineering/GTM memory, bidirectional production writes, a plugin marketplace, auto-generated legal basis, last-touch ROI optimization or cross-domain auto-promotion.

self_improvement_boundary.loop: Collect redacted trace/evidence → human-reviewed incident/postmortem and eval-case curation → proposal in domain repo → offline replay/property/security tests → non-authoritative shadow → bounded canary → independent evaluation → named promotion or rollback. [S5,S13,S14,S29]
protected_invariants: project/domain isolation and data classification with protected control paths and full-SHA workflow pins [S11]
consumer opt-in and ability to pin/rollback
no training or memory ingestion of consumer content absent explicit purpose-specific agreement
self_improvement_boundary.promotion_classes: Domain prompts/routing/checklists may canary after local evidence. Connectors, schemas and evals need independent owners. Kernel, identity, isolation, policy engine, audit, data export, retention and promotion logic are control-plane changes: cross-domain conformance, security review and human release only; never self-promoted.
self_improvement_boundary.consumer_protection: Use tenant-isolated eval aggregation: submit counters/distributions and incident categories only; minimum cohort/privacy thresholds before fleet analysis; no consumer artifact copied centrally by default. Candidate promotion uses synthetic plus opt-in redacted replay, then central canary, then opt-in cohort. Any leak, cross-tenant read, evaluator tamper, unexplained regression or failed rollback freezes fleet rollout.
self_improvement_boundary.metric_rule: Optimize a scorecard, not activity: outcome/quality, lead time, reviewer burden, cost, reliability, privacy/brand incidents and reversals [S28]. Do not let the proposal agent choose its own metric or holdout.

validation_strategy.schema_contract: JSON Schema positive/negative fixtures, domain-qualified kinds, unknown-field policy, canonical hashing, signature and migration N/N-1 tests [S2,S6].
validation_strategy.state_transition: Model/property tests cover every state/event pair, invalid transition, duplicate/out-of-order delivery, lease expiry/fencing, retry exhaustion, cancellation at every effect boundary, stale approval, crash/replay, outbox loss, reconciliation and rollback.
validation_strategy.isolation_security: Two malicious synthetic tenants; assert no cross-project artifact/search/cache/telemetry/secret access. Test confused deputy, prompt/tool poisoning, SSRF, path traversal, forged manifests, replayed approval, oversized artifact, consent revocation and malicious CRM/web content [S8,S26,S27].
validation_strategy.domain_conformance: Kernel suite knows no Issue/PR/Lead/Campaign symbols. Engineering suite tests commits/checks/deploys. GTM suite tests consent/suppression, claims evidence, brand lint, audience snapshot, approval invalidation, publication dry-run and CRM dedupe. Connector tests use sandboxes and read-after-write.
validation_strategy.dogfood_acceptance: Before self-host writes: 14 consecutive shadow days, 100% duplicate replays idempotent, 100% restoration/replay drills pass, zero cross-project/unauthorized write, and all divergences classified. Before central canary: >=30 representative accepted/closed runs, exact reproduction from locked digests, reviewer evidence-usefulness >=80% on a predefined rubric, and no worse escaped-defect/severity mix than baseline. Freeze on any privilege escape, evidence tamper or failed rollback.
validation_strategy.consumer_acceptance: Across >=2 consumer repos with different owners/stacks and >=100 eligible tasks over >=60 days: zero critical unauthorized/cross-tenant actions, 100% rollback drills, >=99% expected event reconciliation (all remainder explained), no worse matched defect/severity/SLO, and a predeclared meaningful improvement in at least one of lead time, accepted throughput, reviewer minutes or cost without worsening the others beyond margins.
validation_strategy.gtm_acceptance: In read-only/sandbox plus human-publish pilot for >=2 distinct workflows/channels, >=100 artifacts and >=60 days: 100% consent/suppression and exact-digest publication gates, zero unauthorized sends/spend/PII leaks/material unsubstantiated claims, all CRM mutations reversible/deduped, brand/legal correction rate and human review time measured, holdout/experiment definitions locked before exposure, and business outcome interval reported. Volume or content count alone never graduates.

implementation_recommendation.decision: Engineering-first, evidence-gated extraction; GTM is a separately configured consumer domain, not a feature flag in the engineering repository.
phase_0_generic_kernel_now_0_4_weeks: Implement generic run/event/artifact/evidence envelopes; durable ledger/outbox/lease/checkpoint; project isolation; scoped identities; policy/gate/evaluator/connector ports; budgets/kill switch; schema/lock/migration; telemetry/redaction.
Implement engineering package separately: GitHub intake, plan/patch/test/PR/deploy projections, engineering risk/evals and developer metrics.
Protect control paths and build conformance/security/fault suites. No public plugin API promise.
implementation_recommendation.phase_1_self_host_4_8_weeks: Offline then 14-day shadow in central repo; assisted drafts; bounded R0/R1 canary only after dogfood_acceptance. Record baseline, denominators, rejects, reviewer minutes, cost, defects and incidents. Self-hosting proves operability, not generality.
implementation_recommendation.phase_2_consumers_8_16_weeks: Onboard 2-3 opt-in consumer engineering repos with separate installations/keys/stores, pinned versions and rollback. Central updates arrive as reviewed PRs. Collect only redacted outcome aggregates by default. Pass consumer_acceptance before broader rollout.
implementation_recommendation.phase_3_extraction_gate: Extract domain SDK/conformance kit only when: (a) at least 3 materially different workflows across central + >=2 consumer repos implement the same seam; (b) two independent adapter implementations require no kernel patch for >=2 releases/60 days; (c) >=80% of proposed SDK surface has >=2 real call sites and stable semantics; (d) compatibility/security/isolation/rollback gates pass; (e) a named maintainer owns versioning/support. Failed conditions mean refactor internally, not publish SDK.
implementation_recommendation.phase_4_gtm_start_gate: Open GTM repo only after phase 2 reliability, an executive/domain DRI and operators exist, a concrete workflow has baseline pain/value and >=100 expected annual artifacts or equivalent justified volume, data inventory/lawful-basis/retention/deletion/DSR/DPIA review is complete, brand/claims/publication and CRM ownership matrices are signed, sandbox/read-only connectors exist, success/guardrail metrics and experiment design are pre-registered, and incident/kill/retraction runbooks are drilled. Start with research/internal drafts; human publication remains.
implementation_recommendation.phase_5_gtm_authority_gate: Consider narrowly automated reversible internal CRM enrichment only after GTM acceptance and independent privacy/security audit. External sends, spend, pricing, promises, sensitive inference, deletion/merge and public publication remain human-authorized until a separate jurisdiction/channel-specific case with larger denominators and counsel approval is made.
do_not_build_now: in-process arbitrary plugin host or marketplace

conflicts.conflict: Protocol and vendor documentation can be read as evidence that interoperability/automation is ready [S3,S7,S19-S21].
conflicts.resolution: Treat it as capability evidence only. Require local conformance, security, workflow and outcome gates; business authorization is receiver-owned.

conflicts.conflict: Vendor case studies and benchmarks often imply productivity; randomized/field, survey and fresh-benchmark evidence is mixed [S22-S25].
conflicts.resolution: No roadmap gate uses benchmark score or generated volume alone. Use matched local baselines, denominators, quality/incident guardrails and reviewer cost.

conflicts.conflict: A generic SDK early could reduce duplication, but its types would likely encode engineering concepts or lowest-common-denominator abstractions.
conflicts.resolution: Keep internal ports narrow and domain-qualified now; extract only after multiple real implementations stabilize the seam.

conflicts.conflict: Central telemetry accelerates learning, but raw aggregation undermines consumer confidentiality and GTM privacy duties [S5,S17,S18].
conflicts.resolution: Tenant-local evidence by default; export opt-in redacted aggregates with purpose, retention and minimum-cohort controls.

conflicts.conflict: Self-hosting seems strong validation, but a central repository shares the builders' stack and incentives.
conflicts.resolution: Count self-hosting as operability evidence only; require independently owned consumer repos and adversarial isolation tests before extraction.

conflicts.conflict: CRM and ad platforms expose write/experiment APIs [S20,S21], while regulation and attribution uncertainty constrain safe use [S15-S18].
conflicts.resolution: Read-only/sandbox and human-publish first; separate consent, claims, brand, CRM and publication approvals; report causal uncertainty.

uncertainties: The central repository's actual baseline volumes, defect mix, reviewer time, costs and incident history were not available; proposed numeric thresholds are decision rules to pre-register, not empirically validated universal constants.
No independent audit of the proposed runtime, tenant isolation, connectors or self-improvement loop exists.
Exact GitHub/HubSpot/Google plan availability, API behavior and documentation may change after the access date; validate in target tenants.

GTM jurisdictions, data categories, audience sources, channels, CRM schema, brand risk appetite, sales cycle and attribution model are unspecified; these can block GTM start and require counsel/data-owner decisions.
No audited evidence proves one kernel will remain economical across engineering and GTM; extraction can still be rejected after prototypes.
The handoff revocation/deletion protocol needs provider-specific feasibility testing; immutable audit evidence and deletion obligations can conflict and require minimized/tombstoned designs.
Future-dated as-of requirements depend partly on living documents and prior validated studies; stable archived snapshots were not available for every vendor page.

confidence.overall: moderate-high for architecture/governance decision; moderate for staged gates; low for GTM ROI and universal numeric thresholds

claim_levels.generic_runtime_boundary: high—supported by narrow standards plus repeated prior repository findings
claim_levels.engineering_specific_boundary: high—directly follows from domain semantics and least-authority design
claim_levels.dogfood_and_sdk_gates: moderate—auditable and falsifiable but thresholds are locally chosen
claim_levels.GTM_compliance_and_publication_boundary: high at principle level; moderate/low for jurisdiction-specific application
claim_levels.GTM_business_value: low until baseline and controlled pilot data exist
claim_levels.vendor_outcomes: low—documented capability is not audited outcome
